notes: Pack labels fit what's on them. The QR is bigger: it fills from under the case ID box down to the footer (up to 1.6" on half sheets), so it scans from further away. What's in a case shrinks to fit above the footer instead of stopping after three lines, and only ends in "…" when it still doesn't fit. A case ID box that wraps (SLIMPAR_2 + SLIMPAR_1, 2' stair cart (solid)) hugs its text instead of staying full width, a unit's IDs wrap between IDs, never inside one, and a box past two lines gets smaller.
